name: Tanco Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过子公司推进多项新业务：Midports Holdings 与 SPG Qingdao Port Group 签署谅解备忘录，拟在 Port Dickson 开发智能 AI 集装箱港口；Tanco Dot Com 与 China Mobile International 签署谅解备忘录，探索建设 50MW IT Load 数据中心；Tanco Precast Industries 与 King Well Holdings 拟成立合资企业。
overview_en: During the year, the Company advanced several new businesses through its subsidiaries: Midports Holdings signed an MOU with SPG Qingdao Port Group to develop a Smart AI Container Port in Port Dickson; Tanco Dot Com signed an MOU with China Mobile International to explore building a 50MW IT Load Data Centre; and Tanco Precast Industries proposed a joint venture with King Well Holdings.

segments.name: 产业发展/管理
segments.note: 今年公司拟收购 Port Dickson 一幅土地，用于 Port Dickson Free Zone 第一期开发，并拟提供财务援助。
segments.note_en: This year, the Company proposed to acquire a parcel of land in Port Dickson for the first phase development of Port Dickson Free Zone, and proposed to provide financial assistance.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 土地估值报告已提交 Bursa Securities，涉及拟议收购及拟议提供财务援助。
actions.text_en: Valuation report for the land was submitted to Bursa Securities in relation to the proposed acquisition and proposed provision of financial assistance.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 88.50 百万令吉收购 Port Dickson 一幅土地，并拟提供最高 250.00 百万令吉财务援助，用于支付收购及 Port Dickson Free Zone 第一期开发。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of a parcel of land in Port Dickson for RM88.50 million, and proposed provision of financial assistance of up to RM250.00 million to fund the acquisition and the first phase development of Port Dickson Free Zone.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面推进智能 AI 集装箱港口、数据中心及预制构件合资等新业务。
segments.note_en: This year, the Group advanced new businesses including a Smart AI Container Port, a data centre, and a precast joint venture.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Midports Holdings 与 SPG Qingdao Port Group 的谅解备忘录状态更新：双方仍在讨论，最终协议仍在进行中。
actions.text_en: Status update on the MOU between Midports Holdings and SPG Qingdao Port Group: parties remain engaged in discussions and the definitive agreement is still in progress.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Tanco Dot Com 与 China Mobile International 的谅解备忘录状态更新：双方仍在讨论，最终协议仍在进行中。
actions.text_en: Status update on the MOU between Tanco Dot Com and China Mobile International: parties remain engaged in discussions and the definitive agreement is still in progress.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 拟在 Port Dickson 开发智能 AI 集装箱港口。
actions.text_en: 79%-owned subsidiary Midports Holdings signed an MOU with SPG Qingdao Port Group to develop a Smart AI Container Port in Port Dickson.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Tanco Dot Com 与 China Mobile International 签署谅解备忘录，探索在 Port Dickson 开发建设 50MW IT Load 数据中心。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tanco Dot Com signed an MOU with China Mobile International to explore the development and building of a 50MW IT Load Data Centre in Port Dickson.

actions.title: PROPOSED JOINT VENTURE BETWEEN TANCO PRECAST INDUSTRIES SDN BHD AND KING WELL HOLDINGS LIMITED ("PROPOSED JOINT VENTURE")
actions.text: Tanco Precast Industries 与 King Well Holdings 拟成立合资企业，涉及混凝土相关产品的制造、供应和销售。
actions.text_en: Tanco Precast Industries and King Well Holdings proposed a joint venture involving the manufacture, supply and sale of concrete-related products.
